translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

content: Petrus nengelesi'i mian men repo'
Sa'angu' ilio, montorumpaki tempo bo sambayangan, jaam tiga maamaalom, ninsoopmo i Petrus tii Yohanes na Laiganna Alaata'ala.

Indo'o raaya'a nimiile' isian sa'angu' moro'one men tiodaa bo ueronna mian gause repo' ngame-ngamea'po. Sanda' ilio mian repo' iya'a atoron ka' pokelaon karani' soopanna Laiganna Alaata'ala men ngaanon, Soopan Pore, kada' mo'ase'-ase' na mian men minsoop na Laiganna Alaata'ala.
Sarataa mian repo' iya'a nimiile' i Petrus tii Yohanes bo minsoop na Laiganna Alaata'ala, ia nama'ase'mo.
Petrus tii Yohanes rontos nintioki i ia, kasi taeni Petrus, “Tioki i kai.”
Kasi mian repo' iya'a nintioki ari Petrus. Na noana i ia mongooskon too daa isian upa men bo rookononna i raaya'a na ko'ona.
Taeni Petrus, “Mosoni tia salaka' sianta isian na ingku', kasee daa upa a men isian na ingku' rookononku na ko'oom. Mimpu'u na kuasa ni Yesus Kristus samba Nazaret, alaka' tumpang!”
Kasi ia sangkum i Petrus a limana uanan ka' niparaandaki norumingkat. Tempo iya'a uga' sarat tia bokulalina nopoonggormo.
Ia noporoditan rumingkat ka' notumumpang waale'e-le'emari. Kasi ia nongololo' ari Petrus minsoop na Laiganna Alaata'ala. Ia notumumpang ka' molaalonggo' kasi muntunde' Alaata'ala.
Wiwi'na i raaya'a uga' nimiile' i ia tumpa-tumpang muntunde' Alaata'ala,

ka' raaya'a uga' ninginti'i se' mianmo iya'a a men mala' umoruang na “Soopan Pore” na Laiganna Alaata'ala mo'ase'-ase' na mian. Mbali' iya'a raaya'a samba' ka' tangang gause nimiile' upa men nosida iya'a.
Hotba ni Petrus na Laiganna Alaata'ala

Mian men sianmo repo' iya'a ningintoni i Petrus tii Yohanes ka' kinololo-lolo'namo tii raaya'a. Tempona i raaya'a tolu' ira notaka na gandaria men ngaanon “Gandaria Salomo”, wiwi'na mian taka pototende' nintikumi i raaya'a gause samba' tuu'.

Sarataa i Petrus nimiile' mian men nintikumi i raaya'a, ia norobumo taena, “Oo samba Israel! Nongko'upa i kuu se' samba'kon wawau kani'i. Nongko'upa i kuu se' tongko' poto tiok na ko'omai, gause mian men nomokomo tumumpang kaya'a taasi' se' kuasamai a ninsidakon, ka' taasi' se' montookon i kai malolo' na Alaata'ala.

Alaata'ala men soosa'on ni Abraham, Ishak, ka' i Yakub, pulinta, nangangga'imo mian-Na men i Yesus. Mian-Na iya'a kuu rookon na pungkuasai mian, ka' kuu kokundai na arop ni Pilatus. Tempo iya'a bookoi i Pilatus mo'uus munguarkon i Ia.
Ia Mian Molinas ka' Ma'amat. Kasee i kuu nongkokundai i Ia ka' nampari-pari kada' i Pilatus tio mongololoikon pa'ase'muu, men munguarkon sa'angu' mian men bukuan mampapatei mian.
Kuu nampapateimo i Ia, kasee tuutuu'na, Ia a men pimpu'uanna katuo'anna giigii' mian. Alaata'ala nomotuo'imo i Ia noko daa lapus. Wiwi'na iya'a kai poko piile'mo.

Kuu daa nimiile'mo ka' ninginti'imo upa a men ninsidakon mian kani'i sianmo repo'. Ia noonggormo ka' nalesi'mo gause i ia noparasayamo ni Yesus tia kuasa-Na. Gause ia parasaya ni Yesus, mbaka' mian kani'i tuutuu' nalesi'mo koi men kuu piile' koini'i.
Utu-utus! Yaku' inti'i se' i kuu tia tanaasmuu nangawawaukon i Yesus tia wawau men sian kuu inti'i.
Kasee wawaumuu men koiya'a ninsidakonmo upa men ia bantilkon Alaata'ala mbaripianpo na nabii-Na se' Tomundo' Pansalamatkon men nitoonkonmo tiodaa munsuri repaan.
Utu-utus! Mbali' iya'a, sosoli ka' kadaraimo a wawaumuu men ba'idek, ka' parasaya a Alaata'ala kada' sapuion-Na wiwi'na dosamuu,
ka' kada' Tumpu minsidakon i kuu pore a noamuu. Ka' i Ia bo momosuu' i Yesus men ia tukokonmo Alaata'ala bo Tomundo' Pansalamatkon i kuu.
Ia sianpo sida mamarerei surugaa pataka Alaata'ala mungule'kon wiwi'na na dunia koi men tumbe, ka' koi men Ia bantilkonmo na toro pii nabii-Na mbaripianpo.

Musa isian nangaan taena, ‘Alaata'ala Tumpumuu bo manganakat sa'angu' nabii na ko'omuu men simbaya'muu sa'angu' lipu', koi i Ia nomosuu' i yaku'. Kuu tiodaa momorongori wiwi'na upa men ia bantilkon nabii iya'a.
Mian men sian mingimamat upa men ia bantilkon nabii iya'a, mian inono' bo rensakonon oloa na mian men parasayamo na Alaata'ala, ka' silaka'ion.’
Nabii Samuel tia nabii men komburi', wiwi'na nuntundunkonmo upa men nosidamo tempo koini'i.

Toonna Alaata'ala men ia bantilkon nabii iya'a, mase bo ko'omuu. Toon men ia wawaumo Alaata'ala tia pulimuu i Abraham koi kani'imari: ‘Ringkat na lee'em, Yaku' bo mambarakaati wiwi'na lipu' na tano' balaki' kani'i.’

Ya'a mbali' Alaata'ala nungururuki mian-Na ka' nomosuu' i Ia taka na ko'omuu olukon kada' i kuu barakaation-Na. Barakaat-Na koi kani'imari: Ia minsidakon i kuu monsosoli ka' mangkadarai wawaumuu men ba'idek.”
